name: A coordinator role, and a per-project grant that lets a personal agent approve
summary: A project role coordinator between contributor and owner: it approves contributions, triages proposals and holds coordinate; members, worker credentials, archive, the audit and the owner decision on a proposal (project.admin, can_decide) stay the owner's. A grant kept with the project: PUT or DELETE /v1/projects/{id}/agents/{agent}/coordinator, by a project owner or superuser. The agent must be an enabled personal agent in the project, its account a coordinator or owner there (else 409). The grant adds reviews.approve and coordinate to the agent's credentials there only, while its account holds them; nothing else a credential is denied opens, not proposal triage. A granted agent never approves work of its own party, whatever approval_by_another_party says. Read from the live state on every request, by the web service and again by the endpoint, which refuses a block naming another project or capability than the request needs. With the host rule coordinator_writes on the web route decides web approvals by its own authority. A grant ends when it is removed, when the agent leaves the project by any route or its account is removed from it; a lowered account keeps it without effect.
